product_one_liner.value: Sprinto is an autonomous trust and GRC platform that automates compliance, risk management, vendor risk, and AI governance for businesses seeking to maintain security and audit readiness.
product_one_liner.notes: The site describes the platform’s continuous monitoring, evidence collection, compliance, risk, and AI governance functions.

named_customers.notes: Customer names appear in customer stories on Sprinto's customer page.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies San Francisco as the headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company history timeline begins in 2019.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index appears to contain marketing and product content, not at least two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Sprinto has a public documentation site with integration and product help articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board includes openings, but none has an AI, ML, data-science, applied/research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision role title.

model_provider.notes: Sprinto lists OpenAI as an AI subprocessor.

compliance_certs.notes: Sprinto’s trust/compliance information names these certifications or compliance standards.

last_funding.notes: Sprinto announced a $20 million Series B on April 9, 2024.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round is the April 2024 Series B, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists enterprise account executive and sales development representative openings.

launched_6mo.notes: Sprinto AI was introduced on October 6, 2026, within the six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The team page lists leaders but does not establish their join dates, and no dated joining or departure announcement was verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Salesforce and Zoho CRM are explicitly named in accessible documentation. HubSpot and Pipedrive names were identified in Sprinto integration documentation.
